result.summary: Found 1 issue: overlapping text on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card where an 'Order' button/label renders on top of the delivery info text.

issues.description: On the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the text '25–30 min delivery' is overlapped by an 'Order' label, rendering as garbled overlapping text ('25–30Ordermin...'). The Order button appears positioned on top of the metadata line.
issues.suggestion: Fix the z-index/positioning or layout so the Order action does not overlap the delivery time text; reserve space for both elements or move the Order button elsewhere on the card.
